name: Moonshot Generative UI
font_note: Narrative/* (Newsreader) only for model-written prose; UI/* (Plus Jakarta Sans) for everything else.

line/strong.use: Input borders, dividers that must be seen

human/accent.use: Data people entered: entries, endorsements, actions

spark/accent.use: AI-generated only. Spark mark, generated edge, AI action

spark/text.use: AI labels as text (passes AA on surface)

spark/tint.use: Background for AI chips and generating state

spark/action.use: Fill for the Generate button (AA with spark/on)

Narrative/Display.use: AI-written headline. One per screen. Max 110 characters.

Narrative/Body.use: AI-written explanation. Max 280 characters per block.

Narrative/Quote.use: Verbatim human quote surfaced by AI. Never paraphrase inside quote marks.

components.name: gen/atom/icon/spark
components.purpose: Marks AI-generated content. Never decorative.

components.name: gen/atom/icon/arrow-up
components.purpose: Send a question.

components.name: gen/atom/icon/plus
components.purpose: Add data.

components.name: gen/atom/icon/chevron-right
components.purpose: Go to detail.

components.name: gen/atom/icon/check
components.purpose: Confirmed, added.

components.name: gen/atom/icon/lock
components.purpose: Private or paid content.

components.name: gen/atom/icon/regenerate
components.purpose: Regenerate an insight.

components.name: gen/atom/icon/info
components.purpose: Explain how this was generated.

components.name: gen/atom/icon/people
components.purpose: People, sources.

components.name: gen/atom/icon/home
components.purpose: Home tab.

components.name: gen/atom/icon/chart
components.purpose: Company tab.

components.name: gen/atom/icon/credits
components.purpose: Credits earned or spent.

components.name: gen/atom/button
components.purpose: Trigger an action.
components.use_when: Primary: one per screen, the main human action. Generate: the action calls the model. Secondary: alternative action. Ghost: low-emphasis, inline.
rules: Label states the outcome: "Generate summary", not "Submit"
The toast after an action reuses the verb: Generate summary -> "Summary generated"

components.name: gen/atom/chip
components.purpose: Label provenance or status in one or two words.

props.tone: AI | Human | Positive | Caution | Critical | Neutral
props.label: string, max 18 chars

rules: AI tone always shows the spark
Status tones always pair colour with a word

components.name: gen/atom/confidence
components.purpose: Show model confidence for a generated statement.

props.level: High (>=5 agreeing sources) | Medium (2-4) | Low (1 or conflicting)

rules: Low confidence: the narrative must hedge ("may", "early signal")
Never hide confidence on a generated insight

components.name: gen/atom/delta
components.purpose: Period-over-period change.
rules: If "up" is bad for this metric (e.g. churn), swap tone: Up uses critical/fg

components.name: gen/atom/switch
components.purpose: Binary visibility setting for contributed data.

components.name: gen/atom/avatar
components.purpose: Identify a person who contributed or is the subject.

components.name: gen/atom/sparkline
components.purpose: Show direction of a metric over time.
rules: Projections use the AI tone and must be labelled "Projected"
No axes, no gridlines; pair with a metric value

components.name: gen/atom/bar
components.purpose: Show a proportion or compare magnitudes.
rules: Comparison: Primary = the subject, Secondary = the benchmark

components.name: gen/atom/skeleton
components.purpose: Reserve space for content being generated.
rules: Show for at most 8 seconds, then stream text in
Pair with a status line, e.g. "Reading 14 entries"

components.name: gen/molecule/provenance
components.purpose: Attribute a generated block to its sources and confidence.
rules: Mandatory under every gen/insight/*
"How?" opens a sheet listing each source with a link

components.name: gen/molecule/metric
components.purpose: Show one metric with context.

components.name: gen/molecule/suggestion
components.purpose: Offer a next question to ask the model.
rules: Max 3 per screen
Must be answerable from available data

components.name: gen/molecule/feedback
components.purpose: Collect a rating for a generated insight; offer regeneration.
rules: Send {insight_id, rating} to /feedback
Regenerate keeps the same sources and asks for a different angle

components.name: gen/molecule/comparison-row
components.purpose: Compare one group against others.

components.name: gen/molecule/data-row
components.purpose: Show and control one human-contributed entry.
rules: Never render with spark: this is human data
Public entries earn credits when viewed

components.name: gen/molecule/composer-field
components.purpose: Free-text question input for the model.

props.placeholder: string, names the scope: "Ask about your team"

components.name: gen/molecule/next-step
components.purpose: Offer an AI-suggested action the human confirms.

props.step: string, starts with a verb, max 70 chars

rules: Never auto-execute
Max 3 per insight

components.name: gen/molecule/quote
components.purpose: Surface verbatim human evidence.
rules: Never edit words inside the quote marks
Only quote feedback whose author made it public

components.name: gen/molecule/status-line
components.purpose: Show generation progress.

props.status: string, present tense, names data: "Reading {n} entries"

components.name: gen/molecule/text-area
components.purpose: Long-form human input.

components.name: gen/molecule/input
components.purpose: Collect one line of text.

components.name: gen/molecule/stepper
components.purpose: Show position in a multi-step flow.

components.name: gen/molecule/select-chip
components.purpose: Toggle one option; show whether the model proposed it.

props.state: Selected (confirmed by person) | Suggested (proposed by model, not yet confirmed) | Unselected
props.label: string max 28

rules: Model output starts as Suggested; only a tap makes it Selected
Never pre-select on the person's behalf

components.name: gen/molecule/avatar-stack
components.purpose: Represent a group of people compactly.

components.name: gen/molecule/task
components.purpose: A person-authored task.

components.name: gen/insight/narrative
components.purpose: Generated headline summarising everything in scope.
components.use_when: First block of every generated screen.

props.headline: string 60-140 chars, 1-2 sentences, second person for the owner, third person for viewers

rules: Lead with the finding, then the evidence
Include one concrete number when available
If confidence is Low, hedge: "Early signs suggest..."
Never invent names or numbers not present in sources

components.name: gen/insight/trend
components.purpose: Explain a change in one metric over time.
components.use_when: A metric moved more than 5% period over period, or has 3+ periods in one direction.

props.title: string max 70, states the direction
props.body: string max 200, names the cause if sources support it

components.name: gen/insight/comparison
components.purpose: Compare one group against benchmarks.
components.use_when: The subject differs from the benchmark by more than 10%.
rules: Sort benchmarks by value descending
Use the same unit in every row

components.name: gen/insight/evidence
components.purpose: Back a generated claim with verbatim human evidence.
components.use_when: A narrative or insight makes a claim about a person; show the strongest public quote that supports it.

props.why: string max 120, generated, explains the pattern across sources

rules: Only public feedback
Quote is human (no spark); the "why" line is AI (spark)

components.name: gen/insight/risk
components.purpose: Flag something that needs attention and say what to do.
components.use_when: A key result is below 60% of expected pace, a metric fell >10%, or a team lost managers.
rules: Always include at least one next step
Critical only when people or deadlines are affected within 30 days

components.name: gen/insight/next-steps
components.purpose: Turn insights into a short list of human-confirmed actions.
components.use_when: At the end of a screen with at least one risk or growth insight.

props.title: string, names the moment: "For your 1:1 with {name} on {day}"

rules: Steps start with a verb
Never auto-execute; the person adds or dismisses

components.name: gen/state/generating
components.purpose: Hold the place of an insight being generated.
rules: Replace each skeleton as text streams in
After 20 s show "Still working" with a cancel option

components.name: gen/state/not-enough-data
components.purpose: Explain why nothing was generated and how to fix it.
components.use_when: Fewer than 3 entries or 2 feedback notes in scope.
rules: State the exact threshold
Offer the one action that unlocks generation

components.name: gen/state/locked
components.purpose: Show that an insight exists without revealing it.
components.use_when: Viewer lacks access to the sources an insight was generated from.

props.title: string, the insight title is visible

rules: Never generate locked insights from content the viewer could not unlock
Title may be shown; body never

components.name: gen/frame/app-bar
components.purpose: Screen header with context and credit balance.

components.name: gen/frame/composer-dock
components.purpose: Ask the model a question about the data in scope.
rules: Pinned 8px above the tab bar
Answers render as new gen/insight/* blocks, not chat bubbles

components.name: gen/frame/tab-bar
components.purpose: Primary navigation.

props.active: Home | Contribute | People | Company (Company only for leaders)

components.name: gen/insight/team-summary
components.purpose: Summarise one team with a generated read and three metrics.
components.use_when: Teams overview: one per team, sorted by the metric the leader asked about (default: biggest change).

props.read: string max 140, generated, compares to company average
props.metrics: exactly 3 gen/molecule/metric M, each with delta vs company average

rules: Teams under 5 people show only aggregates the grammar allows

components.name: gen/data/task-group
components.purpose: Show a person-authored goal with its tasks and progress.
rules: Human data: never add a spark here
The model may summarise task groups in a narrative, but never edits them

components.name: gen/insight/chart
components.purpose: Show data a sentence cannot: several groups or periods at once.
components.use_when: Bars: compare 2-6 groups or periods, max 2 series. Line: a value over 5+ periods; projections only with Medium or High confidence.

props.title: string max 70
props.body: string max 160, says what to notice

rules: Projected values always use spark/accent dashed and the legend says "Projected"
Max 2 measured series; use a comparison insight for more groups
Never a pie or radar chart

components.name: gen/molecule/nav-item
components.purpose: One destination in the desktop sidebar.

components.name: gen/frame/sidebar
components.purpose: Desktop navigation, account and credit balance. Replaces the tab bar above 1024px.

props.active: Home | Contribute | People | Company | Tasks (Company only for leaders)
props.name: string

rules: Fills the viewport height; content scrolls, the sidebar does not
The model never generates sidebar content

components.name: gen/template/home-owner
components.purpose: Owner home: narrative, evidence, trend, own data, next steps.
rules: Blocks between the app bar and the composer are replaced by generated blocks following the Grammar board
Keep the fixed chrome: app bar, composer dock, tab bar

components.name: gen/template/contribute
components.purpose: Add an entry: text area, AI follow-up, preview of what changes, visibility.
rules: Blocks between the app bar and the composer are replaced by generated blocks following the Grammar board
Keep the fixed chrome: app bar, composer dock, tab bar

components.name: gen/template/profile-viewer
components.purpose: Someone else's profile: generated from public data only, private insights locked.
rules: Blocks between the app bar and the composer are replaced by generated blocks following the Grammar board
Keep the fixed chrome: app bar, composer dock, tab bar

components.name: gen/template/company-overview
components.purpose: Leader overview: narrative, risks, trend, comparison, key numbers, next steps.
rules: Blocks between the app bar and the composer are replaced by generated blocks following the Grammar board
Keep the fixed chrome: app bar, composer dock, tab bar

blocks.body: Their 9 reports have had no 1:1 since. Engagement in that group dropped 14 points.
next_steps: Assign interim managers for the 9 reports

blocks.title: Employee NPS is climbing for the third month
blocks.body: Engineering moved from 31 to 52 after weekly 1:1s started.

steps.text: Assign interim managers for the 9 Sales reports

desktop.grid: primary column fluid + secondary column 400px, 32px gap, 40px padding
desktop.placement: Primary: narrative, critical risks, trends/charts. Secondary: key numbers, caution risks, comparisons, next steps.

tokens_note: GenUI / Color now aliases Moonshot / Primitives (3-tier). Resolve aliases to get hex values.

sample_cast.note: All names and numbers are sample data
